faces.name: The Companion of the Wilds
faces.oracleText:
Old Companion — Your starting deck contains only cards from WOE, WOC, and playtest cards. (You may cast this from outside the game if this is companion without paying {3} first.)
When The Companion of the Wilds enters the battlefield, create a Food token, a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block," and a Royal role token attached to a creature you control.

faces.name: The Conundrum of Bowls
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Seek a card with mana value less than the number of cards in your hand.
II — Seek a card with mana value greater than the number of cards in your hand.
III — Count the number of cards in your hand. You may cast a spell with mana value equal to that number from your hand without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: The Convention Enthusiast
faces.oracleText:
As long as this creature is your commander, you may play cards from any game in your deck as long as they can be reasonably translated into Magic. They all fit within this Commander's color identity.
{1}: Create one resource of any type. (Mana or otherwise.)

faces.name: The Convincing General
faces.oracleText:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
As the game begins, if this creature is your commander, choose two creature types. For the rest of the game, treat those two types like they're the same among your creatures and creature cards everywhere.
{3}, {T}: Choose a creature type. Draw a card for each creature you control of that type.

faces.name: The Cookout Creator
faces.oracleText:
When The Cookout Creator enters, create a Food token.
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 colorless Human creature token for each Food you control.
Tapped four untapped Humans you control: You draw a card and create a Treasure token.

faces.name: The Cosplayzer
faces.oracleText: You may have The Cosplayzer enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has "The first time each turn an ability of this creature is activated or triggered, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy" and the first letter of its name is Z. (This is both stylish AND makes it a different name for the legend rule!)

faces.name: The Council of Four
faces.oracleText:
Whenever a player draws their second card during their turn, you draw a card.
Whenever a player casts their second spell during their turn, you create a 2/2 white Knight creature token.

faces.name: The Countdown Is at One
faces.oracleText: Players play a Magic subgame, starting at 1 life and using their libraries as their decks. For the rest of the main game, if a source would deal damage to a player who didn't win the subgame, it deals double that damage to that player instead.
